name: Sable Vex
summary: Level 7 tiefling Fiend warlock — relentless Eldritch Blast artillery with a burst of pact-slot fire.

actions.name: Eldritch Blast (Cantrip)
actions.description: *Ranged Spell Attack:* +7, range 120 ft, **two beams** (roll each separately — use this action twice). *Hit:* 1d10 + 4 force damage per beam (Agonizing Blast adds Charisma). Add **+1d6 necrotic** against the Hexed target.

actions.name: Hex (1st, cast at 4th)
actions.description: *Bonus Action:* curse a creature within 90 ft. Sable's attacks deal an extra **1d6 necrotic** to it, and it has Disadvantage on checks with one chosen ability. Concentration, up to 24 hours at this slot level; a Bonus Action moves the curse when the target drops.

actions.name: Fireball (3rd, cast at 4th)
actions.description: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a **20-foot-radius Sphere** within 150 ft. *Failure:* 9d6 fire damage (cast with a 4th-level pact slot). *Success:* Half damage.

actions.name: Hellish Rebuke (1st, cast at 4th)
actions.description: *Reaction, when damaged by a creature within 60 ft:* the attacker makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. *Failure:* 5d10 fire damage. *Success:* Half damage.

actions.name: Command (1st, cast at 4th)
actions.description: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, up to **four** creatures within 60 ft. *Failure:* the target obeys a one-word command (Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, or Halt) on its next turn.

senses: Darkvision 60 ft. (sees through magical darkness — Devil's Sight)

traits.name: Pact Magic
traits.description: Charisma caster — spell save **DC 15**, spell attack **+7**. **Two pact slots, both 4th level**, recharged on a Short Rest.

traits.name: Agonizing Blast
traits.description: Adds Charisma (+4) to Eldritch Blast damage (already included).

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Sees normally in darkness, magical and nonmagical, to 120 ft.

traits.name: Dark One's Blessing
traits.description: When Sable reduces a hostile creature to 0 hit points, they gain **11 temporary hit points** (Charisma + warlock level).

traits.name: Fiendish Resilience
traits.description: After a Short or Long Rest, choose one damage type; Sable has resistance to it until the next rest.

traits.name: Infernal Legacy
traits.description: Resistance to fire damage; knows Thaumaturgy.
